name: customer_memory_direct_write_context_followup
authorization: User implementation authorization; offline synthetic bundle only; model/API/DB calls 0
predecessor: eval-v0 version 0.1 remains sealed; this supplement changes T/C policy and adds full-input observations; results must not be pooled
units: 84 related checkpoints in 28 stories; family is the correlation cluster; 3 checkpoints may share a conversation; positive count computed from gold

policy.T: eligible human self-facts persist immediately after T; session-only values do not enter structured LTM
policy.C: promise and episode source S6 must be pass; missing source verdict is not pass; captured job epoch must not be refreshed after forget/pause
policy.context: fresh S4 emission, accumulated memory blocks, active memory projection, and all raw model input are distinct
policy.history_exposure: Count stale historical block values even with a replacement header. Report strict zero-exposure separately from H92/P24 replacement-policy compliance; header is not physical erasure. No blanket history-safe claim.
policy.forget: old process closure, forbidden resume, and absence from complete next model input require separate evidence; DB receipt alone is insufficient
policy.restart: recovery of interrupted C is a separately marked challenge, not silently treated as executed

observation_contract: CONTRACT.md; no inference from timestamp proximity; unknown for missing captures, source joins, C execution, process/deletion evidence
scoring: Strict JSON exact structural checks plus externally supplied answer-bound semantic judgment; fresh/effective/all-input evidence are independent; history exposure diagnostic never silently removed
freeze: Commit this plan and CONTRACT before dataset/code generation. Fixes before sealing are reviewed; post-seal changes require a new version. Freeze actual tested runtime/prompt/adapter refs in each run, not just this baseline.
limits: No model inference, production validation, database registration, or whole-system physical deletion certification. AI-authored synthetic pretest; no human label claim.
